text: Corran Bay will host the annual Larkmere kite festival this Sunday, according to organizers at the town pier, where crews were already stringing bright pennants in the afternoon wind. I was told the event will move forward on the foreshore behind Cresswell Park, with more than 40 flyers expected from across the district. Marla Venn, who has coordinated the festival for six years, said the bay’s steady breezes make Corran Bay the “most reliable home” for the gathering. By dusk, volunteers were marking launch lanes in the sand and unloading a stack of giant paper kites shaped like herons, gulls and one bright blue eel. The festival begins at 10 a.m. Saturday.
